info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, loopX, loopWidth, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, featherXPos, featherYPos, swell, swellList, swellListPointer, swellListPointer1, COPTER, sway, bellRung, feathers, seaGullState, hitRot, bash, featherDelay, cableGuyglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gScore, gDamagePercent, gCableLength, gCableItemon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  feathers = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 1)  cableGuy = sprite(6)  COPTER = sprite(4)  swellList = []  repeat with i = 1 to 90    swellAngle = 4 * i    swellList.add(5 * cos(swellAngle * radians))  end repeat  swellListPointer = 1  swellListPointer1 = 1  swell = 0  hitRot = 0  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 50  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  sway = 0  swellAngle = 0  seaGullState = #FLY  bash = 0  featherDelay = 0  feathers.locZ = 110  featherXPos = -1000  featherYPos = -1000endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    hitRot = hitRot * 0.90000000000000002    bash = bash * 0.94999999999999996    case seaGullState of      #FLY:        if (Xpos > 0) and (Xpos < 512) then          xDiff = COPTER.locH - this.locH          if abs(xDiff) < 30 then            yDiff = COPTER.locV - this.locV            if abs(yDiff) < 15 then              seaGullState = #HIT              featherXPos = Xpos              featherYPos = Ypos              this.member = member(this.memberNum + 1, "Gfx")              puppetSound(3, member(28, "Sfx"))              feathers.locV = this.locV              gDamagePercent = gDamagePercent + 20              if gXVel > 0 then                hitRot = 3234              else                hitRot = -3234              end if              gXVel = 0            end if          end if        end if        xDiff = cableGuy.locH - this.locH        if abs(xDiff) < 30 then          yDiff = cableGuy.locV - this.locV          if abs(yDiff) < 15 then            if (gCableItem = 0) and (gCableLength >= 50) then              seaGullState = #ONCABLE              puppetSound(3, member(29, "Sfx"))              gCableItem = 1            end if          end if        end if        feathers.locH = this.locH        feathers.locV = -1000        this.locH = Xpos + bash + (swellList[swellListPointer] * 5)        this.rotation = (-swellList[swellListPointer1] * 2) + hitRot        this.locV = Ypos + swellList[swellListPointer] + bash      #HIT:        featherXPos = featherXPos + gXVel + gXOffset + (swell * 5)        feathers.locH = featherXPos        feathers.locV = featherYPos        featherYPos = featherYPos + 1        featherDelay = featherDelay + 1        if featherDelay = 3 then          if feathers.memberNum = 105 then            feathers.memberNum = 106          else            feathers.memberNum = 105          end if          featherDelay = 0        end if        this.locH = Xpos + bash + (swellList[swellListPointer] * 5)        this.rotation = (-swellList[swellListPointer1] * 2) + hitRot        this.locV = Ypos + swellList[swellListPointer] + bash      #ONCABLE:        this.locH = cableGuy.locH        this.locV = cableGuy.locV        if gCableLength = 0 then          seaGullState = #INCOPTER          gCableItem = 0          gScore = gScore + 1000          puppetSound(3, member(29, "Sfx"))        end if      #INCOPTER:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000    end case    swellListPointer = swellListPointer + 1    swellListPointer1 = swellListPointer + 2    if swellListPointer > 90 then      swellListPointer = 1    end if    if swellListPointer1 > 90 then      swellListPointer1 = 1    end if  end ifend
